tier: serverless LLM API, default account tier T1

free_tier.stated: apodex/apodex-1.1-mini (256K context) is priced at $0 per million input tokens and $0 per million output tokens on the serverless LLM API; no token quota is stated, and the model is capped by the default per-model limit of 30 requests per minute and 50000000 tokens per minute at tier T1. The $0 price was listed from 2026-10-01 as a launch promotion and was still listed on 2026-11-03
free_tier.notes: the unit is the nearest term: the allowance is a rate limit on a $0-priced model, with no token or credit quota; the key-less model list also prices the chat ids bunny, nvrouter/auto, nvrouter/fusion and dev/glm46 at 0, and no page read documents them or their limits, so only apodex/apodex-1.1-mini is counted; the $100 Sandbox credit is a separate product, in compute/novita

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions, plus Anthropic-style and Responses endpoints listed for the model
tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client with base URL https://api.novita.ai/openai and model id apodex/apodex-1.1-mini; the model list GET /openai/v1/models answers without a key
chaining: one key reaches every Novita-hosted model, so the $0 model and paid models share a key; a single $0 model is the only zero-priced model that a page documents

limits.value: apodex/apodex-1.1-mini default per-model limit by account tier: T1 30 requests per minute, T2 100, T3 1000, T4 3000, T5 6000; 50000000 tokens per minute at every tier; T1 is an account whose monthly top-ups did not exceed $50 in any of the last 3 calendar months
unverified: the $0 price was announced as a launch promotion from 2026-10-01 and a launch post said free for 7 days; it was still listed on 2026-11-03, with no end date stated

limits_note: the rate limits are the vendor's defaults read from its model list; enforcement is not measured

identity_cost.detail: an account created with an email address, Google, GitHub or Hugging Face sign-in; the sign-up page shows no phone or card field. unverified: whether a $0 model call needs a non-zero balance or a top-up, since the FAQ lists insufficient balance as a cause of HTTP 403, and whether apodex/apodex-1.1-mini needs identity verification, since some models do; both are behind a sign-up

reliability_note: the $0 price is a promotion with no stated end date, so the model can turn paid without notice; some models answer HTTP 403 until identity verification
confidence_note: the $0 price, the tier limits and the sign-up options are quoted from vendor pages and the vendor's key-less model list, which a probe read on 2026-11-03; calling the model with a key is not measured

evidence.proved: the product model list prices apodex/apodex-1.1-mini at 0 for input and output tokens
apodex/apodex-1.1-mini has 30 RPM and 50000000 TPM at tier T1 and 100 RPM at T2
the key-less OpenAI-compatible model list of the endpoint prices apodex/apodex-1.1-mini at 0 for input and output
the same list prices a chat model id bunny at 0 too, with no page that documents it
a key-less GET of the OpenAI-compatible model list answered HTTP 200 on 2026-11-03
the public pricing page lists Apodex 1.1 Mini with 256K context at Free input and Free output

evidence.quote: apodex/apodex-1.1-mini is available via Novita's serverless API, where you pay per token.
evidence.proved: the model page offers the model on the serverless pay-per-token API, with the input and output price shown as $0
the model page prices output at $0 per million tokens

evidence.quote: As of October 1, 2026, Novita lists input and output pricing at $0 per million tokens as a launch promotion, so check the live model page before putting the model into a production budget.
evidence.proved: the $0 price is a launch promotion listed from 2026-10-01 and the vendor tells readers to check the live price

evidence.quote: | T1 | Monthly top-ups did not exceed $50 in any of the last 3 calendar months. |
evidence.proved: tier T1 is the account tier with top-ups of at most $50, so an account with no top-up is T1

evidence.quote: Each account has a default rate limit for model calls, measured in RPM (requests per model per minute) and TPM (tokens per model per minute).
evidence.proved: limits are counted per account and per model

evidence.quote: You can use Google or GitHub authentication, or [sign up with your email address](https://novita.ai/user/register).
evidence.proved: an account is created with Google, GitHub or an email address
the sign-up page offers an email form besides the Google, GitHub and Hugging Face buttons and shows no phone or card field

evidence.quote: Product credit and model access can affect whether a request succeeds.
evidence.proved: the quickstart says credit and model access can decide whether an LLM request succeeds, without saying whether a $0 model needs a balance

evidence.quote: Some models require identity verification before your account can access them.
evidence.proved: some models answer HTTP 403 until the account completes identity verification; the page names no model

evidence.quote: 1. Insufficient account balance — top up your account and retry.
evidence.proved: insufficient account balance is a listed cause of an HTTP 403 on a model call; the page does not say whether a $0 model is exempt

evidence.quote: New User Voucher: Available to first-time registered users for trying out services of various types of models.
evidence.proved: first-time registered users get a voucher for model services; no amount is stated

binding_note: the $0 model is bound by its per-model limit of 30 requests per minute at tier T1; its price is a promotion with no stated end
notes: re-check the price on a short interval: it was announced as free for 7 days on 2026-10-01 and was still $0 on 2026-11-03. Same vendor as compute/novita (Agent Sandbox), a different product with its own credit.
